conventions: C-pairing: prices paired by amount and percent, then by evidence overlap, then by field agreement (global greedy); one quicksprout pair that joined two different occurrences was split.

C-included: 'included' holds the allowances or inclusions stated with that occurrence (users, projects, storage, data, devices, minutes, nights, items said to be included), not feature descriptions, delivery formats or 'recommended for' lines.

C-included-bought: the quantity being bought is not repeated in 'included' when it is already in the product name or in basis_quantity; a variant size goes to 'included' only when the product name lacks it.

C-included-conditions: wallet top-up / spend thresholds and validity periods are purchase conditions (included null); a volume tier tied to a per-unit rate ('for a quantity of 5000-10,000 SMS') is kept in 'included' as written.
C-basis-vocab: basis uses the guide's singular generic unit: 'message' for SMS and SMS units.
C-goods-basis: goods sold as a whole item or pack with no 'per' wording have basis and basis_quantity null; a basis is set only when the text states a per-unit (/kg, /lb, / bunch, /pc).

C-names: plan and product as the page writes them at that occurrence (row or column label, heading incl. its descriptor), without footnote markers or embedded prices; an allowance in parentheses goes to 'included'.

C-plan-vs-product: on a vendor's own page separate services are 'product' (plan null) and tiers are 'plan'; on review, comparison and news pages 'product' is the tool or company priced and its tier or service line is 'plan'.
C-product-qualifier: qualifiers of a basis or ticket (employee type, card type, one-way/return, passenger row) are neither product nor plan; they stay in the evidence.
C-addon-name: an add-on's product is the add-on's name as written.

C-tax-scope: tax comes from a statement that covers the price: page-level ('All prices ...', an unscoped '* GST will be charged in addition to mentioned prices', a tax FAQ on fees) applies page-wide; a statement naming one kind of price (MRP) applies only to it; otherwise null.
C-effective-scope: an article-level 'Prices as of' / 'Sources checked on' date applies to every price in the article.
C-billed-scope: a billing commitment stated in an FAQ block ('We only offer annual billing') applies to the prices in that block.
C-period: period only when stated with the amount (incl. 'month-to-month' and a JSON-LD offer's own description); a 'Monthly/Annual billing' row label sets billed, not period.

C-promo: promotional true only on visible evidence (struck/was price, a stated discount, promo or first-term framing); a CSS class or a conflicting figure elsewhere is not evidence, and false is then judgeable.
C-same-offer: repeats of one offer (JSON-LD copy, variant option, per-unit breakdown of a discounted price) carry that offer's stated promotional and tax properties.
C-currency: a bare $ is read as the currency the page itself writes for the same shop's prices ('$9.99 AUD', JSON-LD AUD).
C-attribution: 'none' when no plan or product name exists (tiers named by size, page-wide fees); 'clear' when the product is plain even if the plan is unnamed.

C-unjudgeable: a field is unjudgeable only when the snapshot cannot settle it (toggle state not in HTML, nature of a trial-period price); a field the guide nulls when unstated (period) is not unjudgeable.
C-paise: fast2sms '0.25 paisa' read as INR 0.25 (the page's own tier lists give Rs 0.25/SMS for the same two offers, in a 'highest price' section); all other paise converted as written.
C-illustrative: a generic illustrative example naming no product ('a plan advertised around $3/month ... renew at $10-$18/month') is a not-price (other).
C-approx: 'around the low-$3s' is kept as a price with amount 3, bound about.
C-conflicts-as-written: contradictory figures on one page (instamojo cards vs table, neworg JSON-LD vs visible text, fast2sms Rs 60,000 vs 600000) are all labelled as written.

C-np-merge: not-prices are the union of A and B, merged when amounts match and one evidence contains the other (longer evidence kept); why: 'save X' = savings, 'X% off' = discount, other non-fee percentages = percentage_not_fee, a bundled benefit's worth or another party's price = other.
C-layout: layout is not compared by agree.py; A's value kept where they differ.
